[{"tag": "P004_2", "raw": "Lorry felt giddily uncertain for some few moments whether the late shoemaking might not be a disturbed dream of his own;"}, {"tag": "P004_3", "raw": "for, did not his eyes show him his friend before him in his accustomed clothing and aspect, and employed as usual;"}, {"tag": "P004_4", "raw": "and was there any sign within their range, that the change of which he had so strong an impression had actually happened?"}, {"tag": "P005_1", "raw": "It was but the inquiry of his first confusion and astonishment, the answer being obvious."}, {"tag": "P005_2", "raw": "If the impression were not produced by a real corresponding and sufficient cause, how came he, Jarvis Lorry, there?"}, {"tag": "P005_3", "raw": "How came he to have fallen asleep, in his clothes, on the sofa in Doctor Manette\u2019s consulting-room, and to be debating these points outside the Doctor\u2019s bedroom door in the early morning?"}, {"tag": "P006_1", "raw": "Within a few minutes, Miss Pross stood whispering at his side."}, {"tag": "P006_2", "raw": "If he had had any particle of doubt left, her talk would of necessity have resolved it;"}, {"tag": "P006_3", "raw": "but he was by that time clear-headed, and had none."}, {"tag": "P006_4", "raw": "He advised that they should let the time go by until the regular breakfast-hour, and should then meet the Doctor as if nothing unusual had occurred."}]

[{"tag": "P008_5", "raw": "Lorry determined to have the aid he sought."}, {"tag": "P008_6", "raw": "And that aid was his own."}, {"tag": "P009_1", "raw": "Therefore, when the breakfast was done and cleared away, and he and the Doctor were left together, Mr."}, {"tag": "P009_2", "raw": "Lorry said, feelingly:"}, {"tag": "P010_1", "raw": "\u201cMy dear Manette, I am anxious to have your opinion, in confidence, on a very curious case in which I am deeply interested;"}, {"tag": "P010_2", "raw": "that is to say, it is very curious to me;"}, {"tag": "P010_3", "raw": "perhaps, to your better information it may be less so.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P011_1", "raw": "Glancing at his hands, which were discoloured by his late work, the Doctor looked troubled, and listened attentively."}, {"tag": "P011_2", "raw": "He had already glanced at his hands more than once."}, {"tag": "P012_1", "raw": "\u201cDoctor Manette,\u201d said Mr."}]

[{"tag": "P012_2", "raw": "Lorry, touching him affectionately on the arm, \u201cthe case is the case of a particularly dear friend of mine."}, {"tag": "P012_3", "raw": "Pray give your mind to it, and advise me well for his sake--and above all, for his daughter\u2019s--his daughter\u2019s, my dear Manette.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P013_1", "raw": "\u201cIf I understand,\u201d said the Doctor, in a subdued tone, \u201csome mental shock--?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P014_1", "raw": "\u201cYes!\u201d"}, {"tag": "P015_1", "raw": "\u201cBe explicit,\u201d said the Doctor. \u201cSpare no detail.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P016_1", "raw": "Mr."}, {"tag": "P016_2", "raw": "Lorry saw that they understood one another, and proceeded."}, {"tag": "P017_1", "raw": "\u201cMy dear Manette, it is the case of an old and a prolonged shock, of great acuteness and severity to the affections, the feelings, the--the--as you express it--the mind."}, {"tag": "P017_2", "raw": "The mind."}, {"tag": "P017_3", "raw": "It is the case of a shock under which the sufferer was borne down, one cannot say for how long, because I believe he cannot calculate the time himself, and there are no other means of getting at it."}]

[{"tag": "P017_4", "raw": "It is the case of a shock from which the sufferer recovered, by a process that he cannot trace himself--as I once heard him publicly relate in a striking manner."}, {"tag": "P017_5", "raw": "It is the case of a shock from which he has recovered, so completely, as to be a highly intelligent man, capable of close application of mind, and great exertion of body, and of constantly making fresh additions to his stock of knowledge, which was already very large."}, {"tag": "P017_6", "raw": "But, unfortunately, there has been,\u201d he paused and took a deep breath--\u201ca slight relapse.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P018_1", "raw": "The Doctor, in a low voice, asked, \u201cOf how long duration?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P019_1", "raw": "\u201cNine days and nights.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P020_1", "raw": "\u201cHow did it show itself?"}, {"tag": "P020_2", "raw": "I infer,\u201d glancing at his hands again, \u201cin the resumption of some old pursuit connected with the shock?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P021_1", "raw": "\u201cThat is the fact.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P022_1", "raw": "\u201cNow, did you ever see him,\u201d asked the Doctor, distinctly and collectedly, though in the same low voice, \u201cengaged in that pursuit originally?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P023_1", "raw": "\u201cOnce.\u201d"}]

[{"tag": "P024_1", "raw": "\u201cAnd when the relapse fell on him, was he in most respects--or in all respects--as he was then?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P025_1", "raw": "\u201cI think in all respects.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P026_1", "raw": "\u201cYou spoke of his daughter."}, {"tag": "P026_2", "raw": "Does his daughter know of the relapse?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P027_1", "raw": "\u201cNo."}, {"tag": "P027_2", "raw": "It has been kept from her, and I hope will always be kept from her."}, {"tag": "P027_3", "raw": "It is known only to myself, and to one other who may be trusted.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P028_1", "raw": "The Doctor grasped his hand, and murmured, \u201cThat was very kind."}, {"tag": "P028_2", "raw": "That was very thoughtful!\u201d Mr."}, {"tag": "P028_3", "raw": "Lorry grasped his hand in return, and neither of the two spoke for a little while."}]

[{"tag": "P029_1", "raw": "\u201cNow, my dear Manette,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P029_2", "raw": "Lorry, at length, in his most considerate and most affectionate way, \u201cI am a mere man of business, and unfit to cope with such intricate and difficult matters."}, {"tag": "P029_3", "raw": "I do not possess the kind of information necessary;"}, {"tag": "P029_4", "raw": "I do not possess the kind of intelligence;"}, {"tag": "P029_5", "raw": "I want guiding."}, {"tag": "P029_6", "raw": "There is no man in this world on whom I could so rely for right guidance, as on you."}, {"tag": "P029_7", "raw": "Tell me, how does this relapse come about?"}, {"tag": "P029_8", "raw": "Is there danger of another?"}, {"tag": "P029_9", "raw": "Could a repetition of it be prevented?"}, {"tag": "P029_10", "raw": "How should a repetition of it be treated?"}]

[{"tag": "P029_11", "raw": "How does it come about at all?"}, {"tag": "P029_12", "raw": "What can I do for my friend?"}, {"tag": "P029_13", "raw": "No man ever can have been more desirous in his heart to serve a friend, than I am to serve mine, if I knew how."}, {"tag": "P030_1", "raw": "\u201cBut I don\u2019t know how to originate, in such a case."}, {"tag": "P030_2", "raw": "If your sagacity, knowledge, and experience, could put me on the right track, I might be able to do so much;"}, {"tag": "P030_3", "raw": "unenlightened and undirected, I can do so little."}, {"tag": "P030_4", "raw": "Pray discuss it with me;"}, {"tag": "P030_5", "raw": "pray enable me to see it a little more clearly, and teach me how to be a little more useful.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P031_1", "raw": "Doctor Manette sat meditating after these earnest words were spoken, and Mr."}, {"tag": "P031_2", "raw": "Lorry did not press him."}]

[{"tag": "P032_1", "raw": "\u201cI think it probable,\u201d said the Doctor, breaking silence with an effort, \u201cthat the relapse you have described, my dear friend, was not quite unforeseen by its subject.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P033_1", "raw": "\u201cWas it dreaded by him?\u201d Mr."}, {"tag": "P033_2", "raw": "Lorry ventured to ask."}, {"tag": "P034_1", "raw": "\u201cVery much.\u201d He said it with an involuntary shudder."}, {"tag": "P035_1", "raw": "\u201cYou have no idea how such an apprehension weighs on the sufferer\u2019s mind, and how difficult--how almost impossible--it is, for him to force himself to utter a word upon the topic that oppresses him.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P036_1", "raw": "\u201cWould he,\u201d asked Mr."}, {"tag": "P036_2", "raw": "Lorry, \u201cbe sensibly relieved if he could prevail upon himself to impart that secret brooding to any one, when it is on him?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P037_1", "raw": "\u201cI think so."}, {"tag": "P037_2", "raw": "But it is, as I have told you, next to impossible."}, {"tag": "P037_3", "raw": "I even believe it--in some cases--to be quite impossible.\u201d"}]

[{"tag": "P038_1", "raw": "\u201cNow,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P038_2", "raw": "Lorry, gently laying his hand on the Doctor\u2019s arm again, after a short silence on both sides, \u201cto what would you refer this attack?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P039_1", "raw": "\u201cI believe,\u201d returned Doctor Manette, \u201cthat there had been a strong and extraordinary revival of the train of thought and remembrance that was the first cause of the malady."}, {"tag": "P039_2", "raw": "Some intense associations of a most distressing nature were vividly recalled, I think."}, {"tag": "P039_3", "raw": "It is probable that there had long been a dread lurking in his mind, that those associations would be recalled--say, under certain circumstances--say, on a particular occasion."}, {"tag": "P039_4", "raw": "He tried to prepare himself in vain;"}, {"tag": "P039_5", "raw": "perhaps the effort to prepare himself made him less able to bear it.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P040_1", "raw": "\u201cWould he remember what took place in the relapse?\u201d asked Mr."}, {"tag": "P040_2", "raw": "Lorry, with natural hesitation."}, {"tag": "P041_1", "raw": "The Doctor looked desolately round the room, shook his head, and answered, in a low voice, \u201cNot at all.\u201d"}]

[{"tag": "P042_1", "raw": "\u201cNow, as to the future,\u201d hinted Mr."}, {"tag": "P042_2", "raw": "Lorry."}, {"tag": "P043_1", "raw": "\u201cAs to the future,\u201d said the Doctor, recovering firmness, \u201cI should have great hope."}, {"tag": "P043_2", "raw": "As it pleased Heaven in its mercy to restore him so soon, I should have great hope."}, {"tag": "P043_3", "raw": "He, yielding under the pressure of a complicated something, long dreaded and long vaguely foreseen and contended against, and recovering after the cloud had burst and passed, I should hope that the worst was over.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P044_1", "raw": "\u201cWell, well!"}, {"tag": "P044_2", "raw": "That\u2019s good comfort."}, {"tag": "P044_3", "raw": "I am thankful!\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P044_4", "raw": "Lorry."}, {"tag": "P045_1", "raw": "\u201cI am thankful!\u201d repeated the Doctor, bending his head with reverence."}]

[{"tag": "P046_1", "raw": "\u201cThere are two other points,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P046_2", "raw": "Lorry, \u201con which I am anxious to be instructed."}, {"tag": "P046_3", "raw": "I may go on?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P047_1", "raw": "\u201cYou cannot do your friend a better service.\u201d The Doctor gave him his hand."}, {"tag": "P048_1", "raw": "\u201cTo the first, then."}, {"tag": "P048_2", "raw": "He is of a studious habit, and unusually energetic;"}, {"tag": "P048_3", "raw": "he applies himself with great ardour to the acquisition of professional knowledge, to the conducting of experiments, to many things."}, {"tag": "P048_4", "raw": "Now, does he do too much?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P049_1", "raw": "\u201cI think not."}, {"tag": "P049_2", "raw": "It may be the character of his mind, to be always in singular need of occupation."}]

[{"tag": "P049_3", "raw": "That may be, in part, natural to it;"}, {"tag": "P049_4", "raw": "in part, the result of affliction."}, {"tag": "P049_5", "raw": "The less it was occupied with healthy things, the more it would be in danger of turning in the unhealthy direction."}, {"tag": "P049_6", "raw": "He may have observed himself, and made the discovery.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P050_1", "raw": "\u201cYou are sure that he is not under too great a strain?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P051_1", "raw": "\u201cI think I am quite sure of it.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P052_1", "raw": "\u201cMy dear Manette, if he were overworked now--\u201d"}, {"tag": "P053_1", "raw": "\u201cMy dear Lorry, I doubt if that could easily be."}, {"tag": "P053_2", "raw": "There has been a violent stress in one direction, and it needs a counterweight.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P054_1", "raw": "\u201cExcuse me, as a persistent man of business."}]

[{"tag": "P054_2", "raw": "Assuming for a moment, that he _was_ overworked;"}, {"tag": "P054_3", "raw": "it would show itself in some renewal of this disorder?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P055_1", "raw": "\u201cI do not think so."}, {"tag": "P055_2", "raw": "I do not think,\u201d said Doctor Manette with the firmness of self-conviction, \u201cthat anything but the one train of association would renew it."}, {"tag": "P055_3", "raw": "I think that, henceforth, nothing but some extraordinary jarring of that chord could renew it."}, {"tag": "P055_4", "raw": "After what has happened, and after his recovery, I find it difficult to imagine any such violent sounding of that string again."}, {"tag": "P055_5", "raw": "I trust, and I almost believe, that the circumstances likely to renew it are exhausted.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P056_1", "raw": "He spoke with the diffidence of a man who knew how slight a thing would overset the delicate organisation of the mind, and yet with the confidence of a man who had slowly won his assurance out of personal endurance and distress."}, {"tag": "P056_2", "raw": "It was not for his friend to abate that confidence."}, {"tag": "P056_3", "raw": "He professed himself more relieved and encouraged than he really was, and approached his second and last point."}]

[{"tag": "P056_4", "raw": "He felt it to be the most difficult of all;"}, {"tag": "P056_5", "raw": "but, remembering his old Sunday morning conversation with Miss Pross, and remembering what he had seen in the last nine days, he knew that he must face it."}, {"tag": "P057_1", "raw": "\u201cThe occupation resumed under the influence of this passing affliction so happily recovered from,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P057_2", "raw": "Lorry, clearing his throat, \u201cwe will call--Blacksmith\u2019s work, Blacksmith\u2019s work."}, {"tag": "P057_3", "raw": "We will say, to put a case and for the sake of illustration, that he had been used, in his bad time, to work at a little forge."}, {"tag": "P057_4", "raw": "We will say that he was unexpectedly found at his forge again."}, {"tag": "P057_5", "raw": "Is it not a pity that he should keep it by him?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P058_1", "raw": "The Doctor shaded his forehead with his hand, and beat his foot nervously on the ground."}, {"tag": "P059_1", "raw": "\u201cHe has always kept it by him,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P059_2", "raw": "Lorry, with an anxious look at his friend. \u201cNow, would it not be better that he should let it go?\u201d"}]

[{"tag": "P060_1", "raw": "Still, the Doctor, with shaded forehead, beat his foot nervously on the ground."}, {"tag": "P061_1", "raw": "\u201cYou do not find it easy to advise me?\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P061_2", "raw": "Lorry. \u201cI quite understand it to be a nice question."}, {"tag": "P061_3", "raw": "And yet I think--\u201d And there he shook his head, and stopped."}, {"tag": "P062_1", "raw": "\u201cYou see,\u201d said Doctor Manette, turning to him after an uneasy pause, \u201cit is very hard to explain, consistently, the innermost workings of this poor man\u2019s mind."}, {"tag": "P062_2", "raw": "He once yearned so frightfully for that occupation, and it was so welcome when it came;"}, {"tag": "P062_3", "raw": "no doubt it relieved his pain so much, by substituting the perplexity of the fingers for the perplexity of the brain, and by substituting, as he became more practised, the ingenuity of the hands, for the ingenuity of the mental torture;"}, {"tag": "P062_4", "raw": "that he has never been able to bear the thought of putting it quite out of his reach."}, {"tag": "P062_5", "raw": "Even now, when I believe he is more hopeful of himself than he has ever been, and even speaks of himself with a kind of confidence, the idea that he might need that old employment, and not find it, gives him a sudden sense of terror, like that which one may fancy strikes to the heart of a lost child.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P063_1", "raw": "He looked like his illustration, as he raised his eyes to Mr."}]

[{"tag": "P063_2", "raw": "Lorry\u2019s face."}, {"tag": "P064_1", "raw": "\u201cBut may not--mind!"}, {"tag": "P064_2", "raw": "I ask for information, as a plodding man of business who only deals with such material objects as guineas, shillings, and bank-notes--may not the retention of the thing involve the retention of the idea?"}, {"tag": "P064_3", "raw": "If the thing were gone, my dear Manette, might not the fear go with it?"}, {"tag": "P064_4", "raw": "In short, is it not a concession to the misgiving, to keep the forge?\u201d"}, {"tag": "P065_1", "raw": "There was another silence."}, {"tag": "P066_1", "raw": "\u201cYou see, too,\u201d said the Doctor, tremulously, \u201cit is such an old companion.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P067_1", "raw": "\u201cI would not keep it,\u201d said Mr."}, {"tag": "P067_2", "raw": "Lorry, shaking his head;"}, {"tag": "P067_3", "raw": "for he gained in firmness as he saw the Doctor disquieted. \u201cI would recommend him to sacrifice it."}]

[{"tag": "P067_4", "raw": "I only want your authority."}, {"tag": "P067_5", "raw": "I am sure it does no good."}, {"tag": "P067_6", "raw": "Come!"}, {"tag": "P067_7", "raw": "Give me your authority, like a dear good man."}, {"tag": "P067_8", "raw": "For his daughter\u2019s sake, my dear Manette!\u201d"}, {"tag": "P068_1", "raw": "Very strange to see what a struggle there was within him!"}, {"tag": "P069_1", "raw": "\u201cIn her name, then, let it be done;"}, {"tag": "P069_2", "raw": "I sanction it."}, {"tag": "P069_3", "raw": "But, I would not take it away while he was present."}, {"tag": "P069_4", "raw": "Let it be removed when he is not there;"}]

[{"tag": "P069_5", "raw": "let him miss his old companion after an absence.\u201d"}, {"tag": "P070_1", "raw": "Mr."}, {"tag": "P070_2", "raw": "Lorry readily engaged for that, and the conference was ended."}, {"tag": "P070_3", "raw": "They passed the day in the country, and the Doctor was quite restored."}, {"tag": "P070_4", "raw": "On the three following days he remained perfectly well, and on the fourteenth day he went away to join Lucie and her husband."}, {"tag": "P070_5", "raw": "The precaution that had been taken to account for his silence, Mr."}, {"tag": "P070_6", "raw": "Lorry had previously explained to him, and he had written to Lucie in accordance with it, and she had no suspicions."}, {"tag": "P071_1", "raw": "On the night of the day on which he left the house, Mr."}, {"tag": "P071_2", "raw": "Lorry went into his room with a chopper, saw, chisel, and hammer, attended by Miss Pross carrying a light."}, {"tag": "P071_3", "raw": "There, with closed doors, and in a mysterious and guilty manner, Mr."}]
